errors.what: First v3.0 Roundup was a naive Math.ceil(x*10)/10; the oracle fixture caught 7 of 3,000 vectors disagreeing (5.0*0.92 -> 4.7). Fixed to the exact reading; naive kept as an audit explainer.

First post description was 213 characters; check_post_frontmatter.py caught it before merge.

Finding past explore ideas meant grepping 8,000+ JSON records; a `promptctl.py ideas --track explore` listing of notes would save time.

deviations.why: 'Calculators are a poor use of a run': a CVSS scorer is calculator-shaped. Did it anyway because the depth is the audit of whole reports, the vector diff and exact rounding that chatbots get wrong; measured with an exhaustive oracle check.
deviations.did: Built scorer + diff + report audit + CLI with --strict, with a measured guide page
deviations.result: Merged with 33 tests; the measurement produced a publishable finding (3.0 and 3.1 base scores identical over the whole space)

notes: Explore idea: CVSS v3 vector checker (no venture covered CVSS). Engine differential-tested against Red Hat's cvss PyPI 3.6: 0 differences on all 259,200 base+temporal vectors per version and 200,000 random environmental vectors. Findings: base/temporal identical across 3.0 and 3.1; environmental differ by 0.1 only with Changed modified scope (6.3% of uniform sample, 0.3% change band); naive 3.0 ceiling wrong on 228 temporal scores. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README holds everything a next run needs. Next: CVSS 4.0.
